test_title: PYST 2: SSC CHSL - Reasoning (Held On: 09 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All N are Q.

II. Some H are Q.

**Conclusion:**

I. Some Q are N.

II. Some Q are H.

III. Some N are H.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follows
Both conclusions II and III follows

solution:
Given Statements:

I. All N are Q.

II. Some H are Q.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2ad9ef84101fea3345277b2a45aed6b5ee6d2d9a2b64cfea56fb1e7e5b825954.png] 

Conclusion:

I. Some Q are N - True (Because All N are Q, so some Q are also N).

II. Some Q are H - True (Because Some H are Q, it means Some Q are also H).

III. Some N are H - False (Because there is no direct relation given between N and H, so it can be possible only).

So, Both conclusions I and II follows.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.
